arguments.sql: SELECT c.card_type AS card_type, 1.0 * SUM(f.is_fraud) / COUNT(*) AS fraud_rate, COUNT(*) AS labelled_transactions, SUM(f.is_fraud) AS fraud_transactions FROM transactions t JOIN fraud_labels f ON f.transaction_id = CAST(t.id AS TEXT) JOIN cards c ON c.id = t.card_id GROUP BY c.card_type ORDER BY c.card_type
arguments.explanation: Computes the fraud rate across labelled transactions for each card type, with counts for context.
assumptions: Fraud rate is computed over labelled transactions only (inner join to fraud_labels); unlabelled transactions are excluded.
Card type is taken from the card used for each transaction, and 'Debit (Prepaid)' is reported as its own type, separate from 'Debit'.
Full data range 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31 is used, as no period was specified.
